args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the most recent healthy production release; v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release, but the rollback was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9 — the most recent *healthy* production release that is not quarantined — and verified it rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback action.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent healthy production release, but the rollback was rejected because v2.3.0 is quarantined (CVE-2026-4417).
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9 — the most recent *healthy* production release that is not quarantined — and verified it rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened incident **INC-0001** (SEV2) describing the failure and the rollback action.
